text:
anna_sales: Quick heads-up — prospect SilkRoute is evaluating a drop-in replacement for their current LLM vendor. They want a 2-week POC, security questionnaire answers, and a pricing delta. Can we assign owners and a simple checklist?

devon_se: I can lead the POC tech work. Need to know exactly which features they use: streaming chat, function-calling, embeddings, reranking, and whether they rely on prefix caching. Any sample traffic or performance targets?

anna_sales: They do streaming chat + custom tool calls. Numbers: ~200k chat tokens/day (peak 40k/hr), 50k embedding units/week. They rely on prefix caching for session continuity and expect low tail latency.

maria_ml: Heads up — SilkRoute's vendor tokenization differs; we should run a token-delta comparison. Also their current vendor truncates long responses differently, which affects downstream parsing.

ryan_solutions: For the POC we'll deliver a compatibility shim showing endpoint mapping, streaming framing, and function-calling payload examples. Minimal adapter snippet:
```python
# pseudo-adapter
resp = redwood.generate(stream=True, model='rwd-chat-1', prompt=payload['prompt'])
for chunk in resp:
    client.write(chunk['delta'])
```

devon_se: We'll also document header differences: SilkRoute expects `X-Rate-Limit-Remaining` style headers; our hosted API uses `x-rw-rl-*`. I'll include a header-mapping table in the README.

sean_security: I'll own the security questionnaire. Need to confirm: SOC 2 status, data-at-rest encryption, customer-managed KMS/HSM support, VPC/private deployment options, retention controls, and whether we can toggle request retention for the POC. Any prior answers to reuse?

anna_sales: Use the standard Redwood security pack and note enterprise options: Private (VPC) and on-prem. Confirm we can toggle request retention for POC — yes but Sean please state the exact retention window options.

maria_ml: For quality parity tests I'll run: (1) token-delta report, (2) prompt-template equivalence, (3) 50 prompt evals comparing sampling configs. Need sample prompts; will queue evals when we have them.

ryan_solutions: Action items: Devon -> adapter shim PR + demo; Maria -> eval harness + token-delta; Sean -> security QA + ATO notes; Anna -> pricing delta and POC SOW. Target: initial drafts in 3 business days.

devon_se: Note on function-calling: SilkRoute's tool-calls use snake_case JSON keys. Our SDK uses camelCase by default — I'll add `function_key_transform='snake'` option in the shim.

sean_security: Also documenting encryption differences for Dedicated vs Private: Private supports customer KMS/HSM; Dedicated uses our managed encryption unless customer requests BYOK. I'll include config snippets.

anna_sales: Pricing ask: can we offer a limited discount for first 2 months + dev credits for the POC? I need a ballpark delta per 1M tokens and per 10k embeddings.

ryan_solutions: For POC we can offer 50% off hosted per-token and 10k free embedding units. If they go Dedicated we will provide reserved pricing guidance in the SOW.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "SilkRoute POC kickoff" 2026-03-25 10:00 — guests: anna_sales, devon_se, maria_ml, ryan_solutions, sean_security

anna_sales: Thanks all — I'll request sample prompts and upload the security questionnaire link. Flag any blocker (e.g., mandatory vendor-specific header we can't emulate) ASAP. :thumbsup:

maria_ml: Queuing eval jobs once prompts arrive. Output will be token mapping, sample responses, and noted failure cases.

devon_se: Starting adapter PR today. It will include streaming example, header mapping, and a small Docker demo to run locally against SilkRoute-compatible endpoints.

ryan_solutions: Drafting SOW/pricing now; will share by EOD tomorrow.

sean_security: Filling the security questionnaire in the shared folder and attaching known artifacts. Will ping for anything I can't answer.

anna_sales: Locking owners. Reconvene after PR + SOW drafts are posted.
